# Moon 0.4.3 beta
Less waiting. More of the page.
- Avoid repeated page-script setup when the site's scripts and options are unchanged. Changes to script objects, content worlds, privacy-related options and site styles still trigger a fresh installation. - Show a ready first frame immediately, and remove a sleeping tab's preview when the page actually paints. - Cancel obsolete recovery work when you navigate elsewhere. Slow navigations are allowed to finish without being restarted by the recovery timer. - Simplify the sidebar dock to Extensions, Bookmarks, Downloads, Translate and Orbit. Profile and space buttons are removed from the dock; existing profiles and spaces are preserved. - Swipe right on the sidebar to open the New Space card. Short or cancelled swipes leave your current space alone. Creating the space still requires confirmation in the card. - Preserve native WebKit image decoding, video playback, cache validation and connection handling. No image downscaling, forced low-bitrate streaming, custom proxy or certificate bypass is introduced. - What's New contains this release only.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. One signed DMG serves installation and in-app updates. This Moon beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. The optional ActivityWatch companion is distributed separately by its authors.
